authority.rule: The workflow architect specifies and recovers the topology but never becomes a competing master orchestrator.

evidence_priority: validated live readback and accepted receipts
durable runtime registries and continuity manifests

runtime_registry.binding_rule: Resolve a stable role_id to a replaceable runtime thread ID at send time.
runtime_registry.history_rule: Refresh the live registry without rewriting this manifest; preserve prior epochs as related_epochs.
runtime_registry.unknown_rule: An absent or unreadable runtime remains UNKNOWN until positive missing, archived, or superseded evidence exists.

recovery_policy.live_apply_gate: independent acceptance receipt naming the manifest digest and plan digest
recovery_policy.active_turn_rule: Never steer, interrupt, repair, or replace an active task. Queue correlated events through atlas.inbox until a safe boundary is proven.
recovery_policy.unknown_rule: Fail closed on UNKNOWN identity, pin state, active-writer collision, or incomplete post-create readback.
recovery_policy.rollback_rule: Stop after the first failed mutation, retain created runtime IDs, emit a partial-create receipt, and retry by role_id against those retained IDs; never delete as rollback.

transitions.gate: unique role binding or accepted missing proof
title, runtime, pin, prompt, and route readback
bounded work result with verification required
ATLAS MAIN acceptance and zero pending routes
post-create or unarchive readback and route bootstrap proof
exact scope, owner, authority, stop conditions, and collision check
terminal receipt, durable checkpoint, no pending route
replacement packet explicitly assumes the blocker

envelope_contract.canonical_digest: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON payload with sorted keys and compact separators
envelope_contract.source_identity: Every envelope carries source_role_id plus source_runtime thread_id, host_id, and human title. Missing runtime identity fails closed before routing.
envelope_contract.dedupe: Reject or silently suppress an unchanged event_id plus payload_digest. The same event_id with a different digest is a safety incident.
envelope_contract.manual_questions: Use stable question_id, source correlation, created_at, expires_at, exact options/impact, and route_back_role_id. Repeat only OPEN questions; suppress ANSWERED or EXPIRED questions.
envelope_contract.acknowledgement: Acknowledgement is a correlated receipt, never proof that requested work completed.
envelope_contract.supersession: A supersession envelope names every superseded event or runtime epoch and never erases history.

single_writer.root_rule: At most one mutating ATLAS-root implementation writer; ATLAS MAIN remains the authority sink and may coordinate without sharing a mutation lease.
single_writer.owner_rule: At most one mutating writer per owner repository or external resource group; optional scouts are read-only.
collision_detection: multiple active runtimes claiming one logical role without accepted supersession
multiple active mutation leases for one writer_scope
same Git branch attached to more than one worktree
runtime cwd or worktree identity different from the admitted packet
unknown task status at a mutation boundary
single_writer.safe_stop: Make no mutation, preserve both candidates, emit BLOCKED with evidence, and wait for ATLAS MAIN disposition.

phases.success_gate: manifest valid, unique root authority, discovery complete or UNKNOWN preserved
ATLAS MAIN unique, readable, unarchived, and accepted as authority sink
queue contracts read back and routes resolve by logical role
each unique binding is idle or safely queued; writer scopes do not collide
recovery owner and embedded services are mapped without becoming operational writers

serialization_rules: Phase 0 must finish before any runtime mutation.
ATLAS MAIN must be recovered and accepted before any downstream bootstrap message.
Queue surfaces may initialize in parallel only after their titles and stable role IDs are unique.
Owner surfaces may initialize in parallel only across distinct writer scopes.
Bootstrap messages serialize per target and use a stable event_id; never send to an active target.
Pin and post-create readback must finish before a created runtime is placed in the live registry.

Only material, deduped, correlated envelopes wake Main at a safe boundary.
MANUAL_REQUIRED changes become stable questions; silence is not approval.
Answered decisions route back once with source correlation and digest.
Material notification only; no decision ownership.
Exact-head review, CI, merge, and release receipts route to Inbox.
Exact admitted Fitness packets only.
Exact admitted Mazer packets only.
Exact admitted Socials OS packets only.
Exact admitted FawxzzyWeb packets only.
Platform coordinator receives dependency-bounded program packets and no implicit provider authority.
Published Fitness work hands lifecycle monitoring to the control plane.
Published Mazer work hands lifecycle monitoring to the control plane.
Published Socials work hands lifecycle monitoring to the control plane.
Published FawxzzyWeb work hands lifecycle monitoring to the control plane.
Unresolved omissions become bounded research envelopes.
Only material research findings route to Inbox.
Architect returns manifest, plan, health, and proof through Inbox; Main accepts recovery.
Owners emit exact owner exports or BoardEvents; DiscordOS is sole live board writer.
Interruption-recovery wake only; unchanged runs are silent.
Read-only bounded watch; unchanged runs are silent.
Durable transport resolves the current Inbox runtime by role ID.
Delivery proceeds only after digest-based suppression and ledger admission.
Foundation projects accepted state and preserves UNKNOWN.
Lifeline may request a bounded recovery audit but cannot create or archive tasks itself.

health.healthy: unique non-archived binding plus title, prompt markers, runtime policy, pin, route, and readback proof
health.degraded: binding exists but one or more non-collision health checks are unproven or stale
health.missing: complete discovery proves no binding exists
health.duplicate: more than one candidate claims a role without accepted supersession
health.blocked: mutation is unsafe because an authority, lease, dependency, or acceptance gate is closed
health.held: known preserved object intentionally excluded from selection
health.unknown: evidence is unavailable or contradictory and must not be inferred
